caption: The drawing depicts four bird-shaped objects mounted on vertical sticks. The central bird is the largest, colored with a teal head, a greenish-blue beak, a purple and yellow body, and brownish wings with purple tips. This bird is positioned at the top of the tallest stick, which is a light brown color. Flanking this largest bird on both sides are two smaller birds of similar design and coloration, but their bodies are more muted with blue and orange heads, brownish wings, and lighter yellow undersides. These birds are also attached to shorter, light brown vertical sticks. To the right and slightly below the central stick is a fourth stick with a hook-like extension at the top, also in a light brown color, on which a tiny bird shape is hanging downward. The objects are drawn on a light beige background with a faint square border sketched around the group. In the bottom left corner, the text "TULITA WESTFALL" is printed.
title: Bird Stick Pin
